title: Yellow Indian Paneer Rasmalai
description: A nutty and velvety Indian dessert featuring paneer, orange juice, and a gluten-free friendly twist, served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Soak the saffron threads in 1 tablespoon of hot water for 10 minutes.
Combine the crumbled paneer, orange juice, saffron with its water, cardamom powder, and rose water in a blender and blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the almond milk and honey until well combined.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, stir in the chopped pistachios.
Spoon the paneer mixture into a tagliere vessel and serve chilled.
